notes.title: The Inspector is recovering from Games Made in France!
notes.content:
Ciao everyone!

As someone noticed, the demo is not available for download anymore. 
Thank you for your precious feedback, we noticed as the build was really unstable and tended to crash 50% of the time so, instead of having players infuriate for that, we preferred to retire it, to focus on optimization. 

While working on fixing this problem, we are also working on some other stuff to deliver you a better experience in Q1 2023, tentative lunch date for "The Inspector".

New Features:

 The PMF revamping (a special microphone that helps you to find the memories) is ongoing in will be released on playtest branch soon. It has a new tutorial making this instrument easier to use
 A complete saving system is under construction, to let you explore the game in more sessions!



Improvements:

 We are continuing to implement 4 major languages: English, French, Italian, Simplified Chinese
 Now you can skip the intro if you want



Fixes:

 Fixed a bug that prevent use to properly using the stairs in the first beacon
 ENG trailer has some misspelled words
 Subtitles in the intro were not properly visible


Thank you again to all the testers who played the demo!

Ciao,

E.

notes.title: The Inspector @Tiny Teams Festival 2022!
notes.content:
It's been a while, but don't worry, the development is proceeding well!

A lot of stuff going on in the past months, let's check together:

Tiny Teams
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/4ee9763f75a76a78a1827dbe915cc7a4b42dc16d.jpg
The Tiny Teams is a private event on Steam, curated by Yogcast. The payoff for this event is "Micro Studio, Massive Ideas", which perfectly fits with my game! I'm excited to be selected to participate in it!
The event starts on Monday and, for a week-long, the demo will be back, looking forward to your feedback.

Color of Indie
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/525561c6f5bf7edff62e28cd5f54198e371eaf19.png
Color of Indie is a new Tik Tok event where you can showcase your Indie game. Is curated by the creator of Lost Ember. It was a super fun experience, we reach the final stage, but we didn't get the podium!

LappiSoft
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/9457f0005baaa4f2bf4ba801538b86849d51cef0.png
I reached a point that the game lacks in some main points: save system, optimization, and marketing. I decided to ask for some help. Max, from LappiSoft, is the right person to assist me on this path. With his experience, we can reach a more polished final product, without losing the status of Indie Dev. 

Game Mechanics
While the core game is the same, there are some new elements that slightly change the game experience.

Tutorial Screens
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/bd733b13b9d91132f86ace2255ffef957f80cf51.gif
A series of panels will guide you discovering the main aspects of the game. One of the main issues with the last demo was understanding how the world of "The Inspector" works. I think, thanks to these screens, I fix partially the problem.

Binocular
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/85bc95eb6a001e1b25242188aec5f899fba3a064.gif
The Inspector is a small exploration game. You need to find the memories to wake up your patients. But what happens if discovering memories is frustrating? I work on that and decided to insert special equipment, the binoculars, that helps you to recognize the memory's position.

Beacons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/6d276172787be414960ff5c717bb6fffe2f01a01.gif
If finding memories were too hard, finding and deactivating beacons was too easy! So I work also on that. Now, prior to shutdown a beacon, you need to answer a specific question. You can answer to this question only if you have found the related memories. This thing prevents players from shutdown all the beacons before finding memories.

That's all for the moment! Thank you for following my game.

E.

notes.title: The demo season is over!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/96ffd592d26a4be00832b990657cfeba85ea3c6e.gif
Thanks to everyone who has stopped on my page!

During this long week, I received tons of feedback and some of you have made some precious video footage, giving me hints to understand where the major issues with the game are.

Overall this Steam Next Fest was amazing! I'm impressed by the result! 

- 1062 new wishlist (steam)

- 360 unique users have played the demo 

- over 500 joined during stream!


The main problems that the community has found are:

- Pixel graphic. Someone loves it, others really hate it. (there is one guy that asked me if his graphic card is broken...). ACTION ---> pixel graphics should be an option.

- Performance. If the game doesn't run on smooth 60 fps on a potato, people generally tend to think your product is crap. ACTION ---> I need to optimize as much as I can the game!

- PMF. The last portion of the game, where you need to use the PMF, wants really clear. People struggled to understand how it work. ACTION ---> tutorial revamp

Starting from this moment, the Demo will return in a "hidden" state but, if you are interested in helping in testing, you can request access on Discord: http://discord.gg/RZEPW2x6jV 

Wish you the best!



E.
